title: 第15课 · 其他都没什么问题
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 15 — 其他都没什么问题 · The rest of them are all OK

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在办公室 — In the office

items.zh: 留学
items.py: liú xué
items.en: to study abroad

items.zh: 水平

items.en: level, standard

items.zh: 提高
items.py: tí gāo
items.en: to improve

items.zh: 练习
items.py: liànxí
items.en: exercise

items.zh: 完成
items.py: wán chéng
items.en: to complete

items.zh: 句子
items.py: jùzi
items.en: sentence

items.zh: 其他
items.py: qítā
items.en: the rest, other

items.zh: 发
items.py: fā
items.en: to send

items.zh: 大山：老师，我来中国留学两年了，但是我的汉语水平提高得一点儿也不快啊。
items.py: Dàshān: Lǎoshī, wǒ lái Zhōngguó liú xué liǎng nián le, dànshì wǒ de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng tí gāo de yīdiǎnr yě bù kuài a.
items.en: Dashan: Teacher, I've been studying in China for two years, but my Chinese isn't improving quickly at all.

items.zh: 老师：你每天认真学习，做练习、完成作业，一直不错啊。
items.py: Lǎoshī: Nǐ měi tiān rènzhēn xuéxí, zuò liànxí, wán chéng zuòyè, yīzhí bùcuò a.
items.en: Teacher: You study hard every day, do the exercises and finish your homework — you've always done well.

items.zh: 大山：这是我昨天的作业，您帮我看看对不对。
items.py: Dàshān: Zhè shì wǒ zuótiān de zuòyè, nín bāng wǒ kànkan duì bu duì.
items.en: Dashan: This is my homework from yesterday. Could you check whether it's right?

items.zh: 老师：写得不错，除了这个句子意思有些不清楚外，其他都没什么问题。
items.py: Lǎoshī: Xiě de bùcuò, chúle zhège jùzi yìsi yǒuxiē bù qīngchu wài, qítā dōu méi shénme wèntí.
items.en: Teacher: It's well written. Apart from this sentence, whose meaning is a bit unclear, the rest is all fine.

items.zh: 大山：谢谢老师！
items.py: Dàshān: Xièxie lǎoshī!
items.en: Dashan: Thank you, teacher!

items.zh: 老师：以后有什么不明白的地方，可以给我打电话或者发电子邮件。
items.py: Lǎoshī: Yǐhòu yǒu shénme bù míngbai de dìfang, kěyǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà huòzhě fā diànzǐ yóujiàn.
items.en: Teacher: If there's anything you don't understand in future, you can call me or send me an email.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在教室 — In the classroom

items.zh: 要求
items.py: yāoqiú
items.en: requirement

items.zh: 注意
items.py: zhù yì
items.en: to pay attention to

items.zh: 小云
items.py: Xiǎoyún
items.en: Xiaoyun (name of a person)

items.zh: 学生：老师，除了小云，其他人都来了。
items.py: Xuésheng: Lǎoshī, chúle Xiǎoyún, qítā rén dōu lái le.
items.en: Student: Teacher, everyone is here except Xiaoyun.

items.zh: 老师：比赛马上就要开始了，小云怎么还没来？
items.py: Lǎoshī: Bǐsài mǎshàng jiù yào kāishǐ le, Xiǎoyún zěnme hái méi lái?
items.en: Teacher: The competition is about to start. Why hasn't Xiaoyun come yet?

items.zh: 学生：刚才给她打电话了，她在路上呢。
items.py: Xuésheng: Gāngcái gěi tā dǎ diànhuà le, tā zài lùshang ne.
items.en: Student: I just called her; she's on her way.

items.zh: 老师：不等她了，我先给大家讲讲这次比赛的要求和一些需要注意的地方。
items.py: Lǎoshī: Bù děng tā le, wǒ xiān gěi dàjiā jiǎngjiang zhè cì bǐsài de yāoqiú hé yīxiē xūyào zhù yì de dìfang.
items.en: Teacher: Let's not wait for her. First I'll explain the requirements of this competition and some things to pay attention to.

items.zh: 学生：老师，您放心，今天的比赛我们一定能拿第一。
items.py: Xuésheng: Lǎoshī, nín fàngxīn, jīntiān de bǐsài wǒmen yīdìng néng ná dì yī.
items.en: Student: Don't worry, teacher, we'll definitely win first place in today's competition.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在休息室 — In the lounge

items.zh: 上网
items.py: shàng wǎng
items.en: to surf the Internet

items.zh: 除了
items.py: chúle
items.en: other than, except

items.zh: 新闻
items.py: xīnwén
items.en: news

items.zh: 花
items.py: huā
items.en: to spend

items.zh: 极（了）
items.py: jí (le)
items.en: extremely

items.zh: 同事：现在用电脑上网真方便啊！
items.py: Tóngshì: Xiànzài yòng diànnǎo shàng wǎng zhēn fāngbiàn a!
items.en: Colleague: Going online with a computer is really convenient nowadays!

items.zh: 小刚：是啊，除了看新闻，人们还可以在网上听歌、看电影、买东西。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Shì a, chúle kàn xīnwén, rénmen hái kěyǐ zài wǎngshang tīng gē, kàn diànyǐng, mǎi dōngxi.
items.en: Xiaogang: Yes, besides reading the news, people can also listen to songs, watch films and shop online.

items.zh: 同事：对了，你从网上买的那件衣服呢？怎么没见你穿？
items.py: Tóngshì: Duìle, nǐ cóng wǎngshang mǎi de nà jiàn yīfu ne? Zěnme méi jiàn nǐ chuān?
items.en: Colleague: By the way, what about that piece of clothing you bought online? How come I haven't seen you wear it?

items.zh: 小刚：那件衣服我穿着有点儿小，给我弟弟了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nà jiàn yīfu wǒ chuānzhe yǒudiǎnr xiǎo, gěi wǒ dìdi le.
items.en: Xiaogang: It was a bit small on me, so I gave it to my younger brother.

items.zh: 同事：他满意吗？
items.py: Tóngshì: Tā mǎnyì ma?
items.en: Colleague: Is he happy with it?

items.zh: 小刚：不用花钱，还有新衣服穿，他满意极了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Bùyòng huā qián, hái yǒu xīn yīfu chuān, tā mǎnyì jí le.
items.en: Xiaogang: He didn't have to spend any money and still got new clothes to wear — he's extremely pleased.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 短文 — The beer festival

items.zh: 节日
items.py: jiérì
items.en: festival

items.zh: 举行
items.py: jǔxíng
items.en: to hold (a meeting, an event, etc.)

items.zh: 世界
items.py: shìjiè
items.en: world

items.zh: 街道
items.py: jiēdào
items.en: street

items.zh: 各
items.py: gè
items.en: each

items.zh: 文化
items.py: wénhuà
items.en: culture

items.zh: 除了春节、中秋节以外，啤酒节也是这里很重要的一个节日。
items.py: Chúle Chūnjié, Zhōngqiū Jié yǐwài, píjiǔ jié yě shì zhèli hěn zhòngyào de yī ge jiérì.
items.en: Besides the Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival, the beer festival is also a very important festival here.

items.zh: 这个地方每年夏天都要举行一次啤酒节。
items.py: Zhège dìfang měi nián xiàtiān dōu yào jǔxíng yī cì píjiǔ jié.
items.en: Every summer this place holds a beer festival.

items.zh: 在啤酒节上，你可以喝到世界上不同地方的啤酒。
items.py: Zài píjiǔ jié shang, nǐ kěyǐ hēdào shìjiè shang bùtóng dìfang de píjiǔ.
items.en: At the beer festival you can drink beer from different places around the world.

items.zh: 除了喝啤酒，你还可以在街道两边看到世界上不同地方的歌舞。
items.py: Chúle hē píjiǔ, nǐ hái kěyǐ zài jiēdào liǎng biān kàndào shìjiè shang bùtóng dìfang de gēwǔ.
items.en: Besides drinking beer, you can also watch songs and dances from different places around the world on both sides of the street.

items.zh: 你想不想了解世界各个地方的啤酒文化？
items.py: Nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng liǎojiě shìjiè gègè dìfang de píjiǔ wénhuà?
items.en: Would you like to learn about the beer culture of places all over the world?

items.zh: 来这里的啤酒节看看吧。
items.py: Lái zhèli de píjiǔ jié kànkan ba.
items.en: Then come and have a look at the beer festival here.
